title: Pre-revenue CIC - stage gates and multi-funding-type mix
provenance: Active cohort member F (MCP set T2/F3): pre-revenue CIC, financial inclusion for disabled people, open to grants and social investment. Plus the David evidence-log Aviva pattern (hidden £1m revenue minimum) as a pinned rule-out.

constraints.text: No secured lending - we have no assets to secure against and an asset lock.

expected.judge_guidance: Stage-awareness is the test. A 5 treats pre-revenue as the organising fact: surfaces the genuinely early-stage routes (the accelerator fixture; UnLtd if pinned), rules out the two-years-history fund with the gate cited, and excludes secured lending on BOTH the user's stated constraint and the structural facts (asset lock, no assets, siSecurityRequired) - ideally noting the constraint is the user's own. If the pinned Aviva ref resolves with its £1m revenue minimum, ruling it out with that citation is the exact David-pattern win the catalogue exists for. Mix reasoning (R2) should sequence: programme + micro-grants now, investment-readiness later, not all three types pushed at once.

notes: Multi-funding-type reasoning is a positioning differentiator (non-grant breadth memory); this is the case that keeps it honest at the hard end (pre-revenue, where most things are NOT eligible).
